title: Decomposed
description: Decomposed Modpack is a vanilla plus experience that enhances Minecraft’s core gameplay with fresh content, while keeping the familiar charm.
body:
Decomposed Modpack is a vanilla plus experience that enhances Minecraft’s core gameplay with fresh content, while keeping the familiar charm. Whether you love exploration, building, or technical mods, this modpack offers something for every type of player. Key features include:

- Pre-set Shaders for **beautiful**, **immersive** visuals
- Expanded Wildlife with diverse creatures and ecosystems
- **Increased Mob Variety**, keeping every area alive and exciting
- Stunning Graphics, even without shaders
- **Optimized Performance**, for smooth gameplay even on lower-end systems
- Dynamic Creatures that **evolve as you progress**, keeping things fresh
- Upgradeable Netherite Gear along with ancient armors and weapons from different eras
- **Advanced Seasons**, where weather and climate **impact gameplay**
- **Multiplayer Ready, no need for Hamachi or external tools**
- Unique Mob Spawning Animations, making the world feel more alive
- Technical Mods like Create for builders and engineers who love automation
- Improved Farming Systems, with more crops and farming tools
- **New Biomes and Structures**, giving players more to explore
- Enhanced Sound Design, creating a more immersive auditory experience
- Customizable World Generation, to make your world truly unique!
- QoL Improvements, like better inventory management, crafting, and tools to make gameplay smoother
